title: ever ROUX|V-Neck Leaf Sequined Sleeveless A-Line Midi Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Exude sophistication and glamour in this sequined V-neck midi-length evening dress. The sleeveless design and A-line silhouette create a timeless look that is perfect for any formal event. With its shimmering sequin detailing and flattering fit, this dress is sure to make you feel like the belle of the ball.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
